evidence.decision: Maps content/accent/state/text/background roles, chooses semantic versus custom variants and tests glass against underlying content instead of copying dated RGB.
evidence.artifact: Requires a role-to-color mapping plus corrected palette/artifact with stated contrast inputs and results.
evidence.transformation: Finance graph replaces ambiguous green labels/Buy/data with neutral semantic labels, one actionable accent and named/dashed series alongside hue.
evidence.verification: Checks false link appearance, color-only state loss and applicable measured contrast; unknown render/hardware conditions remain unverified.
evidence.applicability: Preserves Mac user accents, TV motion/scale focus, spatial-background context, Watch tinted complications and P3-to-sRGB conversion risks.
evidence.handoffs: Routes appearance transitions to Dark Mode, glass to Materials and broader sensory access to Accessibility.
evidence.distinctiveness: Color meaning, locally adaptive glass and profile conversion drive production roles and evidence requirements.
